comments.note: api-client.test.ts: The file has no wrapping top-level describe block — each API group has its own describe. The afterEach was added at the module scope (same level as beforeAll), which is the correct location given the file structure. The AC language 'top-level describe scope' implicitly refers to this module-level scope since there is no single enclosing describe.

api-client.js (L560–654): The 8 model-related methods now have @throws JSDoc. The @throws tag establishes a consistent documentation pattern that would benefit all other API methods (getRunLogs, getServerInfo, orchestratorStart, etc.) as they also reject on HTTP errors via the same shared `request()` helper. These are out-of-scope for this WP but worth noting.

config-model-registry.js mrValidateSlug(): The prior guard was `if (!slug)` which passes for whitespace-only strings via JS falsy rules. The fix `!slug || !slug.trim()` is minimal and correct. A slight alternative — `if (!slug?.trim())` — would be more idiomatic ES2020+ but the existing file uses classic ES5-style function declarations, so the chosen style is consistent with the surrounding code.
